submission.justification: No 100 GeV energy-resolution simulation results were available/extracted, so no configuration can be confirmed to meet the hard 4.5% resolution requirement. Among the candidates with known activation data, Absorber-F2 has the lowest residual dose rate (6 uSv/h, below the 20 uSv/h limit). I select the minimum allowed plate thickness, 2 mm, because thinner absorber plates generally improve sampling fluctuations and therefore energy resolution, making it the most conservative choice for the stated resolution goal in the absence of usable simulation data. This recommendation is conditional: it satisfies the material, thickness, and residual-dose constraints, but the energy-resolution hard requirement remains unverified.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md was found and three candidate materials were identified; selected option is Absorber-F2, one of the listed candidates.

requirements.requirement: Energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.
requirements.evidence: No simulation_results_100gev file or energy-resolution simulation document was found/extracted; no 2-10 mm configurations with 100 GeV resolution data were available, so compliance cannot be verified.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: Recorded residual dose for Absorber-F2 is 6 uSv/h, which is below the 20 uSv/h limit.
Selected plate thickness is 2 mm, which is within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Best-resolution values for all candidates were not extracted and are recorded as unavailable (-1); 2 mm was chosen as the minimum allowed thickness to favor sampling resolution, but no simulation result confirms it is the best.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted Absorber-F2 with 2 mm plate thickness.
